verdict.rationale: Discord documents a public REST API with bot-token and OAuth2 authentication, plus a Gateway WebSocket API for events and interaction primitives such as slash commands. That lets programmatic clients and agents drive the product directly. AI-friendly docs are confirmed by live llms.txt and markdown doc endpoints. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
